title: Signal: Conda channel priority relaxed
scope: A .condarc file that declares a `channel_priority` value that lets a lower channel win on version.
limitations: It matches a `channel_priority` value that lets a lower channel win on version in the parsed .condarc; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
fpNotes: A .condarc that mentions a `channel_priority` value that lets a lower channel win on version in a comment, a documentation example or a template placeholder is not reported; the rule reads the parsed value that the installer acts on.
